newsitem.title: USA: National Diagnostics obtains $2 mln credit.
newsitem.headline: National Diagnostics obtains $2 mln credit.

text.p: National Diagnostics Inc said Tuesday it has obtained a $2 million line of credit with DVI Business Credit, a subsidiary of DVI Inc.

The line of credit was announced just four days after the company's president and chief operating officer, Curtis Alliston, indicated the company would need additional capital in order to expand further.
Since its initial public offering in September 1994, the company has increased its net revenue to more than $6.2 million in 1995 from $3.7 million in 1994.
Recently, the company completed its first six months of operations in 1996 with revenues in that period approaching $4.5 million.
The company provides diagnostic imaging services, including magnetic resonance imaging, computer tomography and ultrasound, through several outpatient center and mobile facilities in Florida.
